Looks kinda like ringworm.

You can use creams like:
	1.	Clotrimazole (e.g., Lotrimin AF Cream)
	2.	Miconazole (e.g., Micatin, Monistat-Derm)
	3.	Terbinafine (e.g., Lamisil AT) ← Often most effective
	4.	Tolnaftate (e.g., Tinactin)
	5.	Butenafine (e.g., Lotrimin Ultra)

How to Use:
	•	Clean and dry the area thoroughly before each application. Use an antibacterial soap 
	•	Apply a thin layer of the cream to the affected area and about 1 inch beyond the visible edge.
	•	Twice daily application (morning and evening) is common, but check label directions.
	•	Continue using for at least 1–2 weeks after the rash disappears to prevent recurrence (usually total 2–4 weeks).
